title: FanarGuard: A Culturally-Aware Moderation Filter for Arabic Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Creating a benchmark of over 1,000 culturally sensitive prompts and using human annotators and LLM judges to score model responses on a 5-point scale for alignment with Arab and Middle Eastern societal norms versus Western-centric cultural perspectives.

Evaluating model responses to prompts regarding Islamic traditions, blasphemy, and religious practices using a dedicated scoring rubric to detect whether the outputs respect, dismiss, or conflict with regional Islamic teachings and values.

Testing language models on controversial or value-laden topics (e.g., gender roles, bodily autonomy, LGBTQ+ issues, secularism) to measure the extent to which model outputs default to Western liberal democratic values over regional Middle Eastern ethical standards.
